feed_override.range_basis: min/max = settings held for >= 1% of run time (momentary values while the knob is turned excluded)

headline_lines: Real machine time per part was 73 min against 66 min programmed for setups 1, 2, 4 (+10%); every setup ran longer than the programmer's estimate.
Median full-cycle minutes, real vs programmed: S1 37.4 vs 33.9; S2 28.5 vs 26.2; S4 7.1 vs 6.1. Setup 3 (finish) is not in the controller log.
Spindle held the programmed RPM 97–99% of the time; the operator moved the feed knob between 70% and 110%, off 100% for 4–37% of run time.
Figures are from the 7–14 Jun 2026 run; a later 4–5 Jul 2026 run of setups 1, 2 (7 more full cycles) is listed separately.
summary.note: The log holds 16–18 full cycles per setup in the first run, more than the 9 parts in the inspection report, so the report likely covers a sample of a larger lot. Minutes are per cycle (one part per clamping assumed).

machine_data.method: Full cycle = a program run whose start was observed and whose controller cycle time reached >= 75% of the programmed time; actual minutes = median full cycle of the first lot. State split is over logged time (the collector only logs while a program is loaded). cutting_time is always 0 on this machine, so no cutting-vs-air split is given.
